executive_summary.market_context: North Bengaluru's Yelahanka belt is crowded with private health-science and management colleges (Nitte, Aditya, Mahalakshmi, MVM, SB, KNN, Ocean), and students compare them on Careers360, Collegedunia and Shiksha before visiting any college site. The brand keyword 'KCGI' is shared with a Korean investment fund and a Kyoto IT graduate school, both older and with stronger entity signals.
executive_summary.verdict: The live technical foundation is sound: all 49 sitemap URLs return 200 with complete metadata, but two entity risks now need resolving — unverified accreditation claims and a live legacy pharmacy domain that may split KCGI authority.
key_points: All 3 blockers from the 10 November audit are fixed and live: inner pages return 200, emails use @kcgiedu.org, and Privacy Policy and Terms are published.
Blocker 1: the site claims 'NAAC Accredited Grade A' and 'NMC Recognized', while CollegeDekho lists NAAC B+ and NMC only covers medical colleges.
Blocker 2 (conditional on ownership): karnatakacollegeofpharmacy.com is live with the same pharmacy college and address, but does not redirect to kcgiedu.org — a likely authority split.
Live Core Web Vitals could not be measured today because the PageSpeed API returned 429; local performance improvements must be treated as not-yet-live until deployment is confirmed.
kcgiedu.org was #3 for 'kcgi' on 13 November, behind kcgifund.com and kcg.edu. The gap is entity strength (Google Business Profile, Wikidata, listings), not on-page SEO.
Content is now the limiting factor: competitors publish fees and course pages, while KCGI's course data has names only.

blockers.title: Remove or prove the accreditation claims
blockers.detail: The homepage and footer claim 'NAAC Accredited Grade A' and 'NMC Recognized'. CollegeDekho lists NAAC B+, and NMC only recognises medical colleges. An inaccurate accreditation claim is a regulatory and trust risk, and conflicting facts weaken Google's and AI answers' confidence in the entity.
blockers.fix: Confirm the real NAAC grade, year and which institution holds it. Show only documented approvals (with institution and year) in pages/Home.tsx (affiliationLogos) and components/Footer.tsx, and drop NMC.

blockers.title: Resolve the legacy pharmacy domain
blockers.detail: karnatakacollegeofpharmacy.com is still live with the same Karnataka College of Pharmacy and Yelahanka address. If KCGI owns it, search engines can treat it as a separate entity and divide authority.
blockers.fix: Confirm ownership this week. If owned, place 301 redirects from every old URL to the matching kcgiedu.org page (homepage and /about-us/ to /institution/pharmacy as a minimum), retain the domain for at least 12 months, then submit a Change of Address in Search Console.

opportunities.title: Own the 'KCGI' entity in India
opportunities.gap: For 'kcgi', Google's AI Overview and knowledge panel describe a Korean fund and a Kyoto college. KCGI Bengaluru has no knowledge panel, no Wikidata item and a CollegeDekho profile with one review.
opportunities.why: Brand searches are the highest-intent traffic a college gets (admissions, contact, fees), and AI answers are built from entity sources. KCGI is the only KCGI in India, so the local entity is winnable.
opportunities.action: Claim the Google Business Profile, create a Wikidata item, align all social profiles to 'KCGI - Karnataka College Group of Institutions', add both to schema sameAs, and run a genuine review drive after admissions.

opportunities.title: Publish the fees and course facts everyone else hides
opportunities.gap: For 'nursing college yelahanka fees 2026', results are aggregators with conflicting, dated figures. Collegedunia says Karnataka College of Nursing's 2026 fees have not been released.
opportunities.why: Parents shortlist by course plus area plus fees. The first official page with current figures becomes the source aggregators and AI answers quote.
opportunities.action: Publish 2026-27 fee ranges, intake, eligibility and approval for each course on /admissions/fees and the institution pages, starting with nursing, pharmacy and physiotherapy; the code can generate course pages once the data is in constants.ts.

opportunities.title: Win 'pharmacy college Yelahanka' with the institution page
opportunities.gap: Results show Aditya, Mahalakshmi, Nitte and MVM through aggregators. Karnataka College of Pharmacy appears only in third-party listings, which disagree on its founding year.
opportunities.why: No local pharmacy college answers PCI approval, RGUHS affiliation, intake, labs and fees on its own site, so a complete official page can outrank thin listings.
opportunities.action: Expand /institution/pharmacy with the founding year, PCI approval reference, intake per course, faculty list, real lab photos and fee range; then link to it from every aggregator profile.
